# `terraform stacks deployment-step artifacts` reference

Use the `terraform stacks deployment-step artifact` command ouputs artifact information.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks <global-stacks-flags> deployment-step artifacts <options>
```

## Description

The `terraform stacks deployment-step artifacts` command retrieves avalible artifact infomration depending on the requested artifact

You can identify the target deployment step either by providing a deployment step ID directly.

## Options

- `-deployment-step-id`: The ID of the deployment step to artifacts.
    - Required.
    - String data type.
- `-artifact-name`: The ID of the deployment step to artifacts.
    - Required.
    - String data type.
- `-json`: Output results in JSON format.
    - Optional.
    - Boolean flag.
    - Default is false (human-readable output).

## Examples

The following command gets the plan description artifact of the deployment step using the deployment step ID and the plan-description artifact name:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-step artifacts -deployment-step-id step-abc123def456 -artifact-name plan-description
```

The following command gets the apply debug log artifact of the deployment step using the deployment step ID and the apply-debug-log artifact name and outputs it to a file:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-step artifacts -deployment-step-id step-abc123def456 -artifact-name apply-debug-log > output.txt
```
